title: The image API got easier to navigate
summary:
A week of clearer image API documentation, revised model routes, and smaller fixes to how requests are handled.

An OpenAPI spec now describes image prompts, models, parameters, authentication, and rate limits without changing API behavior. Kontext also gained a BPAIGen-first route with a Kontext fallback, a configured maximum side length of 1216 pixels, and an optional guidance_scale control.

GLM-4 9B Chat joined the text models. The openai aliases changed across two updates; by July 31, openai, openai-fast, and openai-roblox routed to Azure GPT-4.1 Nano, and openai-roblox allowed anonymous access. Openai-reasoning was removed from the available model list, while DeepSeek R1 0528 received a 2,000-token maximum output.

Blocked referrers are no longer forced into ad selection. Audio input and token limits were reduced, error logging was hardened for message collections, and image-parameter diagnostics were added.
